notes: 0.3.44：工作区与会话的路径也按「原机器位置 → 本机位置」推断。补齐了 session_projcache 的 record.identity.cwd：以前只改会话日志首帧的 cwd，projcache 仍指着源机目录，所以工作区能列出来、点开历史会话却回不到正确目录。现在 apply 用工作区登记表的 sessionIds 反查该工作区在本机的落点，改写 projcache 里那一个字符串（其余字节不动、幂等）；推断不出来就不改，留给面板提示。推送侧报告分两组：配置文件里的路径 / 工作区与会话记录里的路径，面板分两段列出，都能逐条采纳。
notesEn: 0.3.44: workspace and session paths now follow "original machine location -> this machine location". It fills the gap in session_projcache's record.identity.cwd: only the first frame of the session log was rewritten before, so projcache still pointed at the source machine and a workspace listed fine while its history could not return to the right folder. Apply now looks each workspace up through the registry's sessionIds, finds where that workspace lives here, and rewrites that single string (nothing else changes, idempotent); when it cannot be inferred nothing is touched and the panel reports it. The push report is split into two groups - paths in config files, paths in workspace/session records - and the panel lists them separately, each accept-able.
